    Where is the original LPM restaurant?
    Originally hailing from Nice, LPM has expanded its reach across the globe, with locations in London, Miami, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The Hong Kong branch stays true to its roots, serving up delicious dishes crafted from the finest ingredients.
